comment: Per tool: `required` names the fields the gateway refuses without (a prose entry like 'a OR b' states a one-of rule the schema cannot express); `example` is a minimal VALID request including recommended optionals; every other accepted parameter is declared, with type and description, in the tool's InputSchema (delivered via tools/list). The shapes and field names are the contract; every s3 uri, ARN, and id value is an invented placeholder — substitute your deployment's own. Each submit example passes this gateway's full input validation (pinned by a unit test), so an example that drifts from the real contract fails the build.

<!-- Comment: an invented example prompt -->

Be terse.
